accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot

hypercore_slot_active_after_action.meaning: HyperCore leaves the 0x811 supplied-balance slot readable and active after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active_after_action.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before notifyVaultSupply registers the slot

notify_vault_supply_called.meaning: notifyVaultSupply was called for the target BLP slot

total_backing_signed_reverts.meaning: totalBackingSigned() reverts while the stale supplied entry remains registered
total_backing_signed_reverts.checkpoint: after registration, until removeSuppliedEntry clears it

assumptions: The accepted action and the subsequent notifyVaultSupply call are part of the same supplyToBlp flow for the target BLP slot.
The stale supplied entry persists until removeSuppliedEntry clears it.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact ordering/timing between HyperCore slot activation and notifyVaultSupply beyond possible asynchronous activation, so the condition uses the report-stated registration call without a precise activation checkpoint.

limitations: The impact statement lists three reverting functions; this plan binds only totalBackingSigned() as the representative observable for the single selected impact.
The inactive-slot outcome is potential, not an observed prior state; the condition encodes the report-supported scenario rather than an established fact.
